name: Amber
notes: Both sources give her two builds: a Burst support (Fiery Rain, 1074% ATK in total at level 13) and a Melt Charged Shot carry. The card follows the support build because Game8 lists it first and KQM names it too, and both put the Burst first. The Melt build wants a Shimenawa's Reminiscence or Wanderer's Troupe set with an EM or ATK% Sands and The First Great Magic. KQM's Burst-support ER is 165-175% with a Favonius Warbow and no team proc, so ER 170% is the goal; with Elegy it is 225-240%. Neither source gives crit or ATK goals. The Explosion DMG line marked 'check' is ATK-based. Amber is a 4-star filler and both sources have little for her, so confidence is low.
